scope: Window-dependent fragment-cap fitting and invariant-schema rejection; Debug host geometry and ownership validation. No new throughput measurements or GPU-execution qualification.

behavior.schema_validation: On a failed initial partition, validate the empty invariant prompt before building source fitting costs; invalid schema fragments return their processor error.
behavior.no_partition_fits: Preserve the original processor refusal instead of an incidental candidate-geometry error.
behavior.fast_path: A fitting requested ceiling still prepares its window samples once.
behavior.budgets: Existing fragment, token, preparation-memory and physical-work limits remain enforced.

regression.source_word: A 65,536-byte URL beginning with https://, filled with repeated configuration plus trailing x characters.
regression.text_layout: a b c d <URL> e f g
regression.previous_outcome: BoundaryFragmentLimitExceeded because a synthetic terminal period extends the URL beyond the byte cap.

coverage: Pinned-base tokenizer with the default 65,536-byte fragment cap.
Small deterministic fragment fixture with fitted and explicit-width usage equality.
Cached fitted samples are reused without extra tokenizer calls.
Original oversized source words still return BoundaryFragmentLimitExceeded.
Invalid schema fragments abort before source fitting-cost indexing, within two schema attempts.
Every allocation failure during fragment fitting and cache publication releases owned state.
Existing nonmonotonic fitting, bounded tokenization, work accounting, cancellation, repacking and long-document ownership tests.
validation.prior_gpu_qualification: See gliner-token-fitting-20261103.json at base commit e04da50001; GPU execution was not rerun for this host-only fitting change.

environment.ANTFLY_GLINER25_BASE_MODEL_DIR: Path to the pinned fastino/gliner2.5-base-v1 artifact.
